appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is 'Global Energy Consumption by Source'.
The 'Fossil Fuels (50%)' slice is the largest segment, positioned at the top left of the pie chart.
The 'Nuclear (15%)' slice is the second largest, positioned at the top right.
The 'Renewables (25%)' slice is the third largest, positioned at the bottom left.

public_definitions: Review the global energy mix dashboard, identify the largest global energy consumption source category, then route that source record to priority source monitoring for this reporting cycle.
Use the dashboard to determine which energy source is the largest category in global energy consumption for this routing decision.
Priority source monitoring route: Route Fossil Fuels to priority source monitoring, Route Nuclear to priority source monitoring, Keep Renewables on routine source monitoring.
